items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-07-23, 08-03
items.q: And we were chosen to be the band to go to the Paul Whiteman show.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, and we mentioned Paul Whiteman, but never did he get to that TV show very much. He just barely mentioned it last time I think. What happened with the TV show? How about that?

Let me see, let me put this together. When the junior band, Tony Amarico's, I forget the circumstances. If I'm not mistaken, we had done a couple of Nord TV shows. And TV was pretty hot stuff in those days. I think we only had one channel then, WDSU. And some kind of way or another, we were in some kind of a battle of the bands. And we were chosen to be the band to go to the Paul Whiteman show. Not as contestants. We did not go as contestants. Just as a feature. And we made the trip to Philadelphia by train. And…
